name: mcp-manager
description: Use when creating, registering, reviewing, or debugging MCP tools in apps/mcp-server/. Covers adding tools to any domain (lens/battle/workflow), scaffolding tool files, wiring registration, reviewing MCP PRs, and debugging auth/RPC/transport failures — even when the user doesn't say "MCP" but is working in apps/mcp-server/ or asking about adding AI tool capabilities to LenserFight.
